disclosure: Fictional fintech case. Staffing, systems, hours and targets are assumptions, not client results or industry benchmarks.

workflow.title: Requirements
workflow.input: PAY-142 story, API contract and past payment defects
workflow.manual: Clarify what a retry means and chase answers across time zones.
workflow.ai: Draft ambiguity questions and identify affected payment journeys.
workflow.output: Versioned acceptance criteria and an open-question log
workflow.check: Product owner confirms that a retry uses the same key and returns the original transfer.
workflow.stack: Azure Boards + a proposed context connector
workflow.example: What happens when the provider accepts the payment but the customer sees a timeout?

workflow.title: Test design
workflow.input: Approved behavior, prior scenarios and defect history
workflow.manual: Copy cases between spreadsheets, fill gaps and review duplicates.
workflow.ai: Draft positive, boundary, retry and concurrency cases with requirement links.
workflow.output: Reviewed test matrix with independently defined expected results
workflow.check: Include same-key/different-payload, parallel retry and duplicate callback cases.
workflow.stack: Azure Test Plans; Gherkin if already used
workflow.example: Two concurrent requests with one key must create one transfer and one balanced journal.

workflow.title: Test data
workflow.input: Account schema, balance rules and fixture conventions
workflow.manual: Find eligible accounts, prepare balances and repair reused data.
workflow.ai: Draft seed scripts and scenario combinations using synthetic records.
workflow.output: Versioned fixtures with isolated accounts and known starting balances
workflow.check: Verify relationships and exact balances before running tests.
workflow.stack: PostgreSQL fixtures + Testcontainers for service tests
workflow.example: Payer starts at CAD 1,000.00; recipient at CAD 0.00. Transfer CAD 100.00.

workflow.title: Environment
workflow.input: Build ID, deployment manifest and dependency contracts
workflow.manual: Check deployments and wait for shared payment-provider sandboxes.
workflow.ai: Summarize readiness failures and draft dependency stub mappings.
workflow.output: Reproducible test run with pinned build, data and stub versions
workflow.check: A deterministic preflight checks health, schema and fixture readiness.
workflow.stack: Azure Pipelines + WireMock; existing Azure test environment
workflow.example: The stub accepts a transfer, delays its response and later returns a callback.

workflow.title: Automation
workflow.input: Reviewed scenarios, seed tests and repository conventions
workflow.manual: Write selectors, API requests, assertions and reusable helpers.
workflow.ai: Draft tests in the existing framework and propose maintenance patches.
workflow.output: Reviewed pull request linked to the accepted test matrix
workflow.check: A deliberately broken duplicate-posting variant must fail. No weakened assertions or silent skips.
workflow.stack: REST Assured + JUnit; Playwright for the new web journey
workflow.example: Assert the transfer ID, journal count and balances, not only HTTP 200 or a success toast.

workflow.title: Execution
workflow.input: Approved tests, pinned build and ready environment
workflow.manual: Run regression packs, collect screenshots and repeat failures.
workflow.ai: Recommend affected tests and summarize run evidence.
workflow.output: Runner results, traces and mandatory-suite completion record
workflow.check: Keep the mandatory payment suite while validating selection quality.
workflow.stack: Azure Pipelines; existing Selenium and Appium suites retained
workflow.example: Execute retry tests at the API layer, then check the customer-facing status in the browser.

workflow.title: Triage & retest
workflow.input: Failed assertions, logs, traces, changes and environment state
workflow.manual: Compare failures, find repro steps and coordinate fixes overnight.
workflow.ai: Cluster related failures and draft evidence-linked defect or repair proposals.
workflow.output: Reviewed defect disposition, fix and fresh rerun evidence
workflow.check: Separate product defects, flaky tests and environment faults. Recheck original intent after a patch.
workflow.stack: Playwright traces + pipeline artifacts + Azure Boards
workflow.example: A correct UI toast with two ledger journals is a product defect; changing the assertion is unacceptable.

workflow.title: Release evidence
workflow.input: Results, open defects, waivers and requirement coverage
workflow.manual: Assemble spreadsheets and chase owners for release status.
workflow.ai: Draft the release summary with links and unresolved evidence gaps.
workflow.output: Versioned evidence pack and accountable release decision
workflow.check: Missing evidence remains unknown. A failed money-movement assertion blocks this case's release.
workflow.stack: Azure Test Plans reports + pipeline artifact store
workflow.example: PAY-142 → reviewed test → build → fixture → run → defect disposition → sign-off.

profiles.name: Shared & manual
profiles.recommendation: Begin with requirements, test design and evidence drafts. Establish stable fixtures and repeatable runs before expanding generation.
profiles.gate: One named owner, a repeatable deployment and a trustworthy baseline.

profiles.name: Mixed maturity
readiness: Cloud test environment; data reset shared
Payment API testable; batch dependency shared
Java automation usable; UI pack noisy
Domain expertise strong; automation skills uneven
profiles.recommendation: Pilot payment APIs and one web journey. Add synthetic fixtures, provider stubs and evidence links alongside AI assistance.
profiles.gate: Two comparable assisted release packs, stable mandatory tests and measured review effort.

profiles.name: Repeatable delivery
readiness: Stable APIs, logs and dependency contracts
Coaches, repository access and defined handoffs
profiles.recommendation: Extend generation and triage across more application teams. Evaluate test selection in shadow mode before changing required coverage.
profiles.gate: A second team can reuse the fixtures and templates without the pilot authors.

sources.title: DORA 2025: State of AI-assisted Software Development
sources.use: AI adoption depends on the surrounding delivery system. This informs the readiness profiles; it supplies no savings rate for this case.

sources.title: Microsoft: Azure Test Plans overview
sources.use: Manual and automated testing, traceability and reporting. The case's AI context connectors are proposed integration work.

sources.title: Playwright: Test Agents
sources.use: Planner, generator and healer examples inform the browser workflow. Review and rejection of skipped or weakened tests are proposed pilot requirements.

sources.title: Playwright: Trace Viewer
sources.use: Inspect recorded actions, snapshots and network evidence when diagnosing browser failures.

sources.title: WireMock: Service virtualization
sources.use: Simulate payment-provider behavior for controlled dependency tests. Stub fidelity still needs integration validation.

sources.title: REST Assured
sources.use: An example Java API testing framework that fits the assumed existing skill base.

sources.title: Testcontainers for Java
sources.use: Disposable container dependencies for service tests; requires a compatible container runtime. It does not provision the entire fintech estate.

sources.title: Appium documentation
sources.use: An example automation stack for existing mobile tests. Device availability and app observability still affect delivery.
